best_rules_serialized.name: academic_suffix_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches person names with academic suffixes (MSc, LL.M., etc.) even without preceding titles. Fixed to handle hyphenated names and suffixes.

best_rules_serialized.name: preposition_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names with prepositions like 'auf der', 'von der', 'zu der' which are common in German names (e.g., 'Renata auf der Heyde'). Fixed to capture only the name.

best_rules_serialized.name: born_context_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names following 'geboren am' (born on) which is a common pattern for identifying individuals.

best_rules_serialized.name: accused_context_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names following 'Angeklagte' (accused) or 'Angeklagten' to identify defendants, ensuring only the name is captured.

best_rules_serialized.name: verb_context_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names following verbs like 'ist', 'wurde', 'lebte' which often precede person names in legal texts, specifically for cases like 'lebte mit Ernst Schoenekaess'.

best_rules_serialized.name: senatspraesident_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names following 'Senatspräsidenten', 'Senatspräsidentin', 'Vizepräsidenten', 'Vizepräsidentin' to avoid matching the title or preceding institution.

best_rules_serialized.name: family_relation_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names following family relation terms like 'von' in 'Eltern von' or 'Mutter von' to identify persons without titles.

best_rules_serialized.name: witness_context_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names following 'Zeuge', 'Zeugin', 'Zeugen' (witness) to identify witnesses in legal texts.

best_rules_serialized.name: first_name_only_title
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches titles followed by a single capitalized word (e.g., 'Dr. Heinrich') to handle cases where the surname is not part of the entity or is separated by context.

best_rules_serialized.name: no_title_conjunction
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names with prepositions like 'auf der', 'von der' but strictly requires the preceding word to be a valid name component, not a title or institution.

best_rules_serialized.name: role_followed_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Captures names immediately following legal roles like 'Senatspräsidenten', 'Hofrat', 'Vizepräsidenten' to avoid matching the title itself.

best_rules_serialized.name: party_context_name
